en: Sepia-toned street view of a historic European town. The image shows a broad cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides, with pedestrians, horse-drawn carts, and early 20th‑century street life. In the distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire. At the top of the postcard is printed the title indicating the town and street name. Several shop signs are visible on the buildings along the right side.
